name: Palmulae
description: Palmulae is a home for new apps and businesses, all pulling in the same direction.
lede: Palmulae is a home for new apps and businesses, all pulling in the same direction. Each new one adds another oar to the boat.
ventures_intro: Each one has its own page here and its own colors, the way every rowing club paints its own blades.
og_image_alt: A Roman galley with its oars pulling as one, the name Palmulae, and the line Row together, go faster.
